name: WALL-OSS 0.5
license_note: No license on the model card; the wall-x code is Apache 2.0.
notes: WALL-OSS 0.5, the May 2026 release (4B: the Qwen2.5-VL-3B backbone plus action components), co-trained with a multimodal objective; its card claims no erosion of vision-language ability. Every layer has two experts with separate attention projections, norms and FFNs: expert 0 has Qwen's widths and is the VL expert copied onto Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, with its fused qkv (q 2048, k 256, v 256 rows, as WallOSS05Attention reads them) and fused gate_up (chunked in half, also in the vision blocks) split first; the q and k bias slices match Qwen's exactly, which pins the boundaries. Expert 1 (width 1024) is the action expert and is excluded. The original x-square-robot/wall-oss-flow (Sept 2025) stores per-expert FFNs only and was replaced by this release.
